database_description: Curated analytical store integrating FAA Aircraft Registry, DOT BTS TranStats On-Time Performance (Q1 2024), and NASA ASRS incident reports for terminal airspace risk analysis across the New York Metro terminal airspace (JFK, LGA, EWR).

dim_faa_acftref.description: FAA Aircraft Reference dimension mapping manufacturer/model codes to aircraft specifications and weight bands.

mfr_mdl_code.description: FAA 7-character alphanumeric manufacturer and model identifier code.

manufacturer.description: Normalized aircraft manufacturer name (e.g., BOEING, AIRBUS, BOMBARDIER).

model_name.description: Specific airframe model designation (e.g., A320-232, 737-8, CL-600-2D24).

type_acft_code.description: FAA aircraft type code (e.g., 4 = Fixed Wing Single-Engine, 5 = Fixed Wing Multi-Engine).

weight_code.description: FAA gross weight classification band (CLASS 1: <=12,499 lbs; CLASS 2: 12,500-19,999 lbs; CLASS 3: >=20,000 lbs transport category; CLASS 4: UAS/drone).

dim_aircraft_registry.description: FAA Master Civil Aircraft Registry dimension storing individual airframe registrations and standardized wake turbulence classifications.

n_number.description: Civil aircraft tail registration number without leading 'N' prefix (e.g., 485PX, 912XJ).

mfr_mdl_code.description: Foreign key reference linking to dim_faa_acftref.

model_name.description: Airframe model name used for widebody prefix pattern matching.

wake_turbulence_class.description: Standardized ATC wake vortex category derived from airframe specifications: Small (<=41,000 lbs MTOW), Large (41,001-300,000 lbs MTOW narrowbodies/regionals), Heavy (>300,000 lbs MTOW widebodies like B767/B777/B787/A330/A350), or Super (A380).

fct_terminal_arrivals.description: DOT BTS domestic commercial scheduled flight arrivals terminating at New York metro hubs (JFK, LGA, EWR) during Q1 2024 (Jan-Mar). Filtered for non-cancelled, non-diverted operations.

carrier.description: Reporting air carrier IATA/DOT code (e.g., DL, AA, UA, B6).

tail_num.description: Aircraft registration tail number as reported by carrier (e.g., N485PX).

dest_airport.description: Destination terminal hub code: JFK (John F. Kennedy), LGA (LaGuardia), or EWR (Newark Liberty).

crs_dep_time.description: Computer Reservation System scheduled departure local time (hhmm).

actual_dep_time.description: Actual gate pushback departure local time (hhmm).

dep_delay_min.description: Gate departure delay in minutes (negative represents early pushback).

taxi_out_min.description: Taxi-out duration from gate departure to wheels-off in minutes.

taxi_in_min.description: Taxi-in duration from touchdown to arrival gate in minutes.

arr_delay_min.description: Arrival gate delay relative to scheduled arrival in minutes.

actual_elapsed_time_min.description: Actual executed gate-to-gate duration in minutes.

air_time_min.description: Airborne flight duration from wheels-off to wheels-on in minutes.

buffer_delay_min.description: Primary continuous regression target (Delta t): ActualElapsedTime - CRSElapsedTime in minutes. Measures terminal sequencing delay, tactical airborne vectoring/holding, and arrival ground congestion beyond scheduled padding.

delay_due_carrier.description: Delay attributed to carrier operations (maintenance, crew, boarding) in minutes.

delay_due_weather.description: Delay attributed to extreme meteorological conditions in minutes.

delay_due_nas.description: Delay attributed to National Airspace System terminal airspace congestion, ground stop programs, or volume delays in minutes.

delay_due_security.description: Delay attributed to security breaches or terminal re-screening in minutes.

delay_due_late_aircraft.description: Propagated rotational delay from upstream late-arriving aircraft in minutes.

wake_turbulence_class.description: Wake vortex class resolved via left join against dim_aircraft_registry (Large vs Heavy).

fct_asrs_incidents.description: NASA Aviation Safety Reporting System confidential incident reports curated across terminal airspace operations.

acn_id.description: NASA ASRS Accession Control Number (unique report identifier).

year_month.description: Year and month of the safety incident event (YYYYMM).

flight_conditions.description: Reported meteorological condition: VMC (Visual), IMC (Instrument), Marginal, Mixed, or Unknown.

light_condition.description: Ambient lighting condition (Daylight, Night, Dawn, Dusk).

acft1_model.description: Reported make and model designation of primary reporting aircraft (Aircraft 1).

flight_phase.description: Operational phase of flight during incident inception (e.g., Final Approach, Initial Approach, Descent, Landing, Taxi).

operating_far_part.description: FAA regulatory operational authority: Part 121 (Commercial Air Carrier), Part 91 (General Aviation), Part 135 (Commuter/On-Demand), or Part 107 (Commercial UAS).

is_multi_aircraft.description: Binary flag indicating whether a second airframe was actively involved in the proximity encounter (1 if Aircraft 2 is populated, 0 otherwise).

primary_problem.description: ASRS expert analyst assessment of root problem category (e.g., Human Factors, Procedure, Ambiguous, Airspace Structure, Weather).

is_severe_anomaly.description: Primary binary classification target for Hypothesis 1: 1 if anomaly descriptors contain Conflict NMAC, Wake Vortex Encounter, Loss Of Aircraft Control, or CFTT/CFIT; 0 otherwise.

took_evasive_action.description: Secondary tactical response target: 1 if flight crew executed an evasive maneuver or abrupt break-off avoidance; 0 otherwise.
